spans.s:
कोट (टः) 1.
m. A fort; a hut; cur-
vature; crookedness.

कोट्ट (ट्टः-ट्टं) 1.
m. A fort, a castle.

कोटक (कः-की-कं)
a. Binding.
m. A
thatcher, builder of huts.

कोटर (रः-रा) 1.
m. n. Hollow of a
tree.
f. Durgā; naked woman.

कोट्टा_र (रः) 1.
m. A well; stairs of
a pond; a fort; a libertine.

कोटरा-वण (णं) 1.
n. A wood in
which there are hollow trees.

कोटवी (वी) 3.
f. A naked woman;
the goddess
Durgā.

कोट्टवी (वी) 3.
f. A naked woman;
Durgā; the mother of
Vāṇa.

कोटि (टिः) 2.
f. The edge or point
of a sword; end of a bow;
[]
a crore; eminence; upright side
of a triangle; complement of an
arc; a plant.

कोटी (टी) 3.
f. The edge or point of
a sword; Medicago esculenta.

कोटिक (कः) 1.
m. A worm.

कोटि-जित् (त्) 5.
m. Kālidāsa.

कोटि-ज्या (ज्या) 1.
f. The cosine of an
angle in a right angled triangle.

कोटि-पात्र (त्रः) 1.
m. A rudder, or
large oar used as one.

कोटीर (रः) 1.
m. Long entangled
hair; a crest, a diadem.

कोटि-वर्ष (र्षं) 1.
n. Vānapuri or
Devikotī on the Coromandal
coast.
f. (षा) A plant (Medica-
go esculenta).

कोटी-वर्ष (र्षं) 1.
n. See कोटिवर्ष.

कोटिश (शः) 1.
m. A harrow.

कोटी_श (श-) 1.
m. A harrow.
adv. By millions.

कोट्टवी-पुर (रं) 1.
n. Vāṇapur.
